traits.ovary_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), genus Crataegus by J. B. Phipps (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perianth and androecium epigynous; carpels partially adnate to the hypanthium, which persists on the pome.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), genus Crataegus by J. B. Phipps (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals 5, white, more or less circular (elliptic in a few series), the base barely clawed, margins more or less entire.

traits.petal_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), genus Crataegus by J. B. Phipps (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals more or less circular, so their tips are rounded.
